note: Buchanan County VA publishes no zoning districts: its ecode360 code has only Chapter 51 subdivision and Chapter 25 building provisions, and no county zoning layer exists in ArcGIS Online or the county's mapping tool. The only incorporated town, Grundy (county seat), routes zoning permits to the county building code office and publishes no zoning ordinance or map. No city of note exists in the county to fall back on.
